query:
SELECT
    sp.id AS "profile_id!: Uuid",
    checks.company_name_exists AS "company_name_exists!",
    checks.company_url_exists AS "company_url_exists!",
    checks.company_description_exists AS "company_description_exists!",
    checks.value_prop_exists AS "value_prop_exists!",
    checks.products_minimum AS "products_minimum!",
    checks.problems_solved_minimum AS "problems_solved_minimum!",
    checks.buying_personas_minimum AS "buying_personas_minimum!",
    checks.persona_pain_mappings_required AS "persona_pain_mappings_required!",
    checks.proof_policy_exists AS "proof_policy_exists!"
FROM organization_seller_profiles sp
CROSS JOIN LATERAL seller_profile_activation_checks_from_content(sp.content) checks
WHERE sp.organization_id = $1
LIMIT 1
